Note: this durability mechanic/bug does not apply to PS3/X360.

  1. Weapons in DS2 break down a lot faster b/c durability programming is tied to frame rates, which is higher on PC and current gen consoles. Every time you hit an enemy your weapon degrades a bit, durability is based on PS3/X360 original game at 30fps, so with 60fps durability loss is 2X

  2. Carry around multiple weapons in case your main weapon becomes 'at risk'.

  3. When it says 'weapon at risk' head to a bonfire and your weapon will be fully auto-repaired. If your weapon is 'broken', you need to go to a blacksmith to reinstate it to a working state. Note that successfully helping someone via summon will restore your weapon's durability.

  4. Carefully mete out your hits. Hits on dead bodies (ragdolls) increase degradation a lot faster than hits on enemies that are alive. Try not to 'chain' too many 'hit combos' as any unnecessary hits will results in faster degradation. Note that 'hitting' friendly co-op allies or PVP enemy players will also result in durability loss similarly to hitting PVE enemies/ragdolls. Also, parrying degrades the weapon/shield that is used to parry, not your main hand weapon).

  5. You may want to start with classes with higher stats in Str/Dex, and/or magic, like the Warrior or Knight or Sorcerer, don't start as Explorer or Deprived as most weapons you will pick up initially will have higher stats than you have and you will not be able to use them and end up with a bunch of broken weapons. Raise Str/Dex initially to 12/12ish at least so you will be able to wield weapons you pick up from enemies and have multiple options when weapons become at risk.

  6. There is a Repair spell that will help you but you need 10Int, ask players and they may provide you with requirements and location (NO spoilers pls). There is also a there's a ring that reduces durability loss, and it's available relatively early in the game (again ask players and no spoilers).

  7. Some players consider this a bug while other players see it as an another risk/reward mechanism to be managed.

  8. Enjoy this extra difficulty curveball, oh FROM/Dark Souls... mouhahahaha

To really push the boundaries of what I thought I could do. I decided I wanted to have a system that acted like an upgrade to the human psychic system. I wanted something that worked extremely well and had simple ways of continuing to work.

A system of 8 sigils connected by 1 more to process someone's intent as if it were one of those old school punch card computers. You insert a said function and it processes that function. I realized during the development not more than a week ago that I'd have a few tasks to hurdle over. These would start with who would be using it. If anyone used it at any given point, it'd need to break down their intent and neutralize it. It'd have to rid the intent of any malice or even happiness, as those can be used for or against the person at large. I sat down just a few days ago and decided to develop the grouping. The input, the cleanse, the maximization, the caching of that intent for others if they have the same thing, the manifestation of that target and it being able to direct it wherever the user wanted, etc. It took a few hours to develop the sigils, but I have my methods. The methods at large are a mix of Grant Morrison's pop magick and my own way of handling sigilum. It's really a customized method per each intent and how I create a basic thoughtform to go with it.

As I said, I wanted to accomplish something I haven't done before. I believe that with the combination of all the symbology (Chaos Star + Buddist Dharma Wheel) and individual work I did on each sigil, as well as the astral development I will "push out" in another "update", that I would be onto something much bigger than I had originally anticipated. When I woke up, my aunt had gotten back and without me asking about food, gave me money for dinner and told me to do whatever I wanted with it. That I feel is the start of a tumbling effect, just as I planned with the system. It's so new right now that I can't speak for everyone else, but it does what it says. It truly magnifies the individuals intent and pushes it out into the world.

In later revisions, I'm hoping to create two more nodes. The astral "cloud" and a forthcoming website designed to act as the physical form of the sigil. I want this system to truly become a hugely diverse system. As if it were a metaphysical ion cannon, blasting your manifestations to you, I'd like to develop this to an ultimate hypersigil. Way beyond the norm.

In short, SAELSTRUM isn't just a simple hypersigil, it's going to become an experiment to what we can truly do with our spirit in communion with it. And truthfully, what it can do against the realm we're in at hand.

I pretend I am growing a bubble of intent in either my head or my hands. This can be done also physically, if you choose to make a physical "bubble" and then push it towards the activation sigil. Either method works for me.
